title: Nike Apocalypse
description: A surreal apocalyptic scene features a giant cracked black Nike-branded sphere floating in a swirling cosmic vortex of blue, purple and red. Below, a skeletal figure in a long coat and antlers stands beside a large iridescent beetle also bearing the Nike logo, in front of ruined classical buildings under a blood-red sky.
prompt: Surreal apocalyptic painting showing a massive cracked black sphere with a dripping white Nike swoosh floating in a swirling cosmic vortex of blue and red energy. In the foreground, a tall skeleton wearing a long coat and deer antlers stands next to a giant shiny beetle with a blue and red Nike logo on its back. Behind them are ruined Greek-style buildings with red glowing windows, set against a dramatic red and black sky with hanging plants and missiles, crowd of silhouettes watching from below, dark fantasy style, highly detailed
